name: EOSP WP-MVP-0002 Authorization Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0002

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  authorize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout authorization branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Assert exact baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "67cbc23acf872440c03c964eb3b4d9fe946ec806"

      - name: Reconcile WP-MVP-0002 and create adoption manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json

          wp_path = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md')
          text = wp_path.read_text()
          old_status = '**Status:** Refined — blocked from Ready by WP-MVP-0001 implementation and ADR-0005'
          assert old_status in text
          text = text.replace(old_status, '**Status:** DRAFT', 1)
          text = text.replace('- proposed ADR-0005', '- ADR-0005')
          text = text.replace(
              '- WP-MVP-0001 must provide valid root/effective configuration.\n- ADR-0005 must establish implementation topology before authorization.',
              '- WP-MVP-0001 is CLOSED and provides the required valid root/effective configuration boundary.\n- ADR-0005 is Accepted and establishes the authorized MVP implementation topology.'
          )
          wp_path.write_text(text)

          manifest = {
              'schema_version': '1.0.0',
              'adoption_id': 'ADOPT-WP-MVP-0002-2026-08-16',
              'reason': 'Adopt the pre-existing WP-MVP-0002 planning artifact into canonical EOS lifecycle control after WP-MVP-0001 closure and acceptance of ADR-0005.',
              'evidence': [
                  'engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0001.md',
                  'architecture/decisions/ADR-0005-mvp-core-implementation-topology.md',
                  'specifications/interfaces/IFC-WORKSPACE-0001-repository-root-and-effective-configuration.md',
                  'specifications/technical/TECH-WORKSPACE-0001-deterministic-workspace-discovery.md'
              ],
              'work_packets': [{
                  'id': 'WP-MVP-0002',
                  'path': 'engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md',
                  'title': 'Deterministic workspace discovery',
                  'status': 'DRAFT',
                  'pi': 'PI-MVP-001',
                  'wc': 'WC-MVP-0001',
                  'domain': 'CORE',
                  'created': '2026-08-12T00:00:00Z',
                  'updated': '2026-08-12T00:00:00Z',
                  'github_url': ''
              }]
          }
          path = Path('.eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0002.json')
          path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY

      - name: Adopt WP-MVP-0002 and pass readiness gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos adopt .eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0002.json \
            --apply \
            --by thomascarter613 \
            --reason "Adopt existing WP-MVP-0002 planning artifact after WP-MVP-0001 closure and resolved ADR-0005 dependency."
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_READY WP-MVP-0002
          ./scripts/eos ready WP-MVP-0002 \
            --by thomascarter613 \
            --reason "WP-MVP-0002 dependency and governing-contract gates are resolved following WP-MVP-0001 closure and accepted ADR-0005."
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_AUTHORIZE WP-MVP-0002

      - name: Authorize WP-MVP-0002
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos authorize WP-MVP-0002 \
            --by thomascarter613 \
            --reason "Human authorization to proceed with WP-MVP-0002 after successful readiness evaluation; conveyed by the project authority on 2026-08-16."
          ./scripts/eos status
          ./scripts/eos next

      - name: EOS verification and projection stabilization
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert authorization invariants and scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json

          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** AUTHORIZED' in wp
          assert 'blocked from Ready' not in wp
          assert 'proposed ADR-0005' not in wp
          assert 'ADR-0005 is Accepted' in wp

          with Path('.eos/work-packets.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              rows = {row['id']: row for row in csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t')}
          row = rows['WP-MVP-0002']
          assert row['status'] == 'AUTHORIZED', row
          assert row['pi'] == 'PI-MVP-001', row
          assert row['wc'] == 'WC-MVP-0001', row
          assert row['domain'] == 'CORE', row

          events = [json.loads(line) for line in Path('.eos/events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
          wp_events = [e for e in events if e.get('target') == 'WP-MVP-0002']
          assert any(e.get('action') == 'adopt' and e.get('to_state') == 'DRAFT' for e in wp_events)
          assert any(e.get('action') == 'ready' and e.get('to_state') == 'READY' for e in wp_events)
          assert any(e.get('action') == 'authorize' and e.get('to_state') == 'AUTHORIZED' for e in wp_events)

          with Path('.eos/decisions.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              decisions = list(csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t'))
          assert any(d.get('target') == 'WP-MVP-0002' and d.get('action') == 'authorize' and d.get('decision') == 'AUTHORIZED' for d in decisions)
          PY

          if git diff --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001\.md$)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected out-of-scope implementation or parent-cycle change detected.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git status --short
          git diff --stat
          git diff -- engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md
          git diff -- .eos/work-packets.tsv

      - name: Collapse bootstrap history into canonical EOSP transaction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="67cbc23acf872440c03c964eb3b4d9fe946ec806"
          BOOTSTRAP_SHA="$GITHUB_SHA"
          rm -f .github/workflows/eosp-authorize-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git reset "$BASE_SHA"
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001\.md$)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected out-of-scope changes staged.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --cached --stat
          git commit -m 'chore(eosp): authorize WP-MVP-0002'

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

          git push \
            --force-with-lease=refs/heads/eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0002:${BOOTSTRAP_SHA} \
            origin HEAD:eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0002
